meta.lb_info:
This file contains the upper bounds (UB) and lower bounds (LB) for the 120-job problems contained in j120.sm.tgz.

The upper bounds are as given in the file j120hrs.sm.

Instances where LB = UB holds (i.e., where the optimal makespan has been verified as LB = UB) are marked with an "*".
